notes: «قال أحمد حدثنا ... وقال الآخران، أخبرنا ابن وهب» : the three co-transmitters share Ibn Wahb as their next link, one level (rule 2)
«أبيه» is bare, so a relation link (rule 7)
Ibn Umar's words «هكذا كان يستجمر رسول الله» are the saying: he is the last link (rule 6)

fixes.reason: K6I's second name is Ahmad b. Hanbal, but the text names Ahmad b. Isa as a co-transmitter of Harun and Abu Tahir
